lucid_implementation: The engine server closes sockets idle for 60 s (desktop/dev.ts Bun.serve idleTimeout); the relay drops guests idle for 120 s (desktop/collab/relay_server.ts idleTimeoutSec).

Algorithms are FIPS-approved (AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256) but run in Bun BoringSSL, which is not FIPS 140-validated. P-FIPS.1 (ADR-0473, in flight) moves them to the OS validated module (CNG / CoreCrypto / OpenSSL FIPS provider).
